title: Tennessee's 6th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: Tennessee's 6th Congressional District is an open seat after incumbent Republican Rep. John Rose opted to run for governor. The district, which covers a portion of Nashville and extends east across north-central Tennessee including Cookeville, was redrawn in May 2026 following a controversial mid-cycle redistricting that shifted district boundaries. The Republican primary features a competitive field including state Rep. Johnny Garrett, former U.S. Rep. Van Hilleary, Marine veteran Jon Henry, and educator Natisha Brooks, while five Democrats are vying for their party's nomination. The district has a Cook Partisan Voting Index of R+13 and was carried by Donald Trump by 27 points, making it a strongly Republican seat in the general election.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this race as of mid-2026. The primary has not yet occurred and the general election candidates are not yet determined.

candidates.name: Natisha Brooks
candidates.summary: Natisha Brooks is a former educator and self-described 'Christian conservative constitutionalist' running for U.S. House in Tennessee's 6th Congressional District. She previously ran for Mayor of Nashville in 2023. Brooks is on the ballot in the August 6, 2026 Republican primary.

candidates.name: Johnny Garrett
candidates.summary: Johnny Garrett is a Tennessee state representative from the 45th district (Goodlettsville area) serving since 2019, and currently serves as House Majority Whip. He is an attorney practicing in Sumner County and a 7th-generation Goodlettsvillian who earned his BS from the University of Tennessee and JD from Nashville School of Law. Garrett is on the ballot in the August 6, 2026 Republican primary for Tennessee's 6th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Jon Henry
candidates.summary: Jon Henry is a Marine Corps veteran with over 20 years of service who earned a Bronze Star for leadership and courage under fire during deployments in Iraq and Afghanistan. A Christian conservative from Riddleton, Tennessee, he earned his PhD in Organizational Leadership in December 2025 while serving. Henry also previously ran for U.S. Senate in 2020 and is on the ballot in the August 6, 2026 Republican primary for Tennessee's 6th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Van Hilleary
candidates.summary: Van Hilleary is a former U.S. Representative for Tennessee's 4th Congressional District, serving from 1995 to 2003, and a Gulf War veteran who flew 24 combat missions as a C-130 navigator. He holds a law degree from Cumberland School of Law and recently served as Chief of Staff for outgoing Rep. John Rose. Hilleary, who also ran for Governor of Tennessee in 2002, is on the ballot in the August 6, 2026 Republican primary for Tennessee's 6th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Lore Bergman
candidates.summary: Lore Bergman is a first-generation immigrant, disability and elderly advocate, and community organizer from Hendersonville who was the Democratic nominee for this seat in 2024. She previously ran for Sumner County Commission and describes her campaign as driven by progressive values and support for working families. Bergman is on the ballot in the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary for Tennessee's 6th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Mike Croley
candidates.summary: Mike Croley is a former federal employee (NOAA), veteran, engineer, and nonprofit founder from Crossville running for Congress. He describes himself as a problem solver whose campaign focuses on affordability, accessibility, and accountability, and he has been critical of the Trump administration's tariff and DOGE-related job cuts that he says affected him personally. Croley is on the ballot in the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary for Tennessee's 6th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Miriam Leibowitz
candidates.summary: Miriam Leibowitz is a Nashville-based Democratic candidate for Tennessee's 6th Congressional District with a background in transportation and community engagement. She has been involved in local Democratic Party organizing and works in commuting and transportation advocacy. Leibowitz is on the ballot in the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary for Tennessee's 6th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Chaney Mosley
candidates.summary: Chaney Mosley is an Army veteran, teacher, and father of three from Nashville running for Congress as a Democrat. His campaign focuses on making life more affordable, strengthening education, investing in rural communities, and protecting democratic institutions. Mosley is on the ballot in the August 6, 2026 Democratic primary for Tennessee's 6th Congressional District.

forecast.rationale: No public polling exists for this race. The general election nominees are undetermined (primaries are August 6, 2026), the district was redrawn in May 2026 via mid-cycle redistricting, and the seat is open — all of which introduce meaningful uncertainty. However, structural fundamentals are overwhelmingly Republican: Cook PVI R+13 and a 27-point Trump margin. In a district this partisan, the Republican nominee — whoever emerges from a competitive four-way primary — is a very strong favorite in the general election. The mid-cycle redistricting could alter the precise partisan composition but is unlikely to flip the district's fundamental character. The absence of polling and the fluid candidate environment preclude high confidence, but the underlying partisan lean clearly supports a Safe Republican rating with an estimated double-digit general election margin.
